findings.evidence: isExternalIconGame returns true for any default_icon_url not starting with 'data:image/webp;base64,'. All 23 seeded games in sql/seed use same-origin '/assets/games/...' paths, and convertIconSourceToDataUrl -> fetchImageFile rejects them in new URL(url) because they are not absolute http(s) URLs.
findings.impact: Seeded games show an incorrect [외부 URL] badge, the bulk button counts them, and every conversion of these rows fails with an error listing the game names; acceptance criterion targets external https URLs only.
findings.recommendation: Treat an icon as external only when it starts with 'http://' or 'https://'; add a test that a '/assets/...' icon gets no badge and is excluded from the bulk count.

findings.evidence: validate_user_character_preset skips the max_preset_slots check on UPDATE when cardinality does not grow, even if game_id changes. Reproduced on local PostgreSQL 17: an authenticated owner moved a 6-character preset to a game with max_preset_slots = 4 (UPDATE 1, stored 6 slots).
findings.impact: Only the owner's own data is affected and the UI never sends this update, but the database no longer guarantees the slot ceiling for presets.
findings.recommendation: Apply the non-destructive exemption only when NEW.game_id = OLD.game_id (same change in sql/SCHEMA.sql) and add a TESTS.sql case for a game_id change above the target ceiling.
